•	Reduce reconfiguration delay in between two launches
•	Maintenance and Operation reduction costs
•	Turn the CSG into an attractive spot for new space operators
•	Improve space base availability
•	Daily life improvement and simplification

Description
In this context, the CNES CSG aims to deliver a new data-sharing platform that could be used by all industrial partners over the Space Centre.
Currently the data sharing in between industrial is complicated. We need a platform that could ensure the security and the sharing of data set that will allow to cover specific use cases such as Supply chain, energy consumptions.
 
The follow up and getting the big picture on those functional needs required to get a unified vision of same data that are held either by on or the other industrial partner on the base.
Setting up a data-sharing platform will enable to easily send/get those data and re-use them either on the platform itself or by importing those data in each industrial partner Information system.
This platform will also have to deliver data mining and data intelligence services so that each partner could use those tools to follow up the actions and dashboards to allow decisions

The expected delivery will consist in deploying the new data sharing platform, train and explain how it works to all industrial partners on the CSG Space port.
